FTTH Broadband Fault Ticket Handling

Document ID: SOP_C25_FTTH_FAULT_HANDLING

Category: C25 — Broadband & FTTH Services

Department: Network

Customer Scope: all

Version: 1.0    Last Updated: 2026-08-08    Source Authority: Internal Knowledge Base

Purpose

To standardise the diagnosis and field-repair dispatch process for home broadband fault reports.

Procedure

Perform remote diagnostics via the ONT telemetry dashboard (PON light status, signal levels).

If LOS is confirmed and not resolved by customer-side checks, log a field fault ticket.

Dispatch a technician within 24 hours for standard faults, 4 hours for enterprise SLA connections.

Apply automatic pro-rated bill credit if downtime exceeds the published SLA threshold.
